rows.target_brief: The complete main-road cross-section between fixed A and B, following the two guide segments through the resort frontage; the guide centerline is only a locator.
rows.notes: The original image and guide were viewed, followed by all four native-pixel crops spanning both fixed endpoints, the intervening segment and both sides. Numerous recognizable panels, frames, furniture and other rubble occupy the central frontage near the guide. However, the sand-covered paved surface joins broad parking/frontage areas, and the heavily disrupted central area does not expose a continuous, reliable pair of main-road edges. A complete road footprint cannot be traced without inventing its boundary. The visible rubble is therefore described here rather than assigned an unsupported obstacle polygon.
uncertainties: The full main-road width and its two continuous edges through the disrupted central frontage cannot be established from this image.
The boundary of the fixed road against the adjoining open paved frontage is unclear; the entire frontage must not be substituted for the road.

rows.target_brief: The complete curving main-road cross-section between fixed A at the right-hand bend and B near the left junction, excluding adjoining driveways.
rows.notes: The full original image and guide were inspected at native resolution. The pale road is visible across the middle and bends right near A, while substantial tree crowns hide its left portion near B and portions around the right bend. Both continuous road edges cannot be established beneath those crowns. Shadows and overhead wires were distinguished from physical road obstructions.
uncertainties: Tree crowns obscure the full road cross-section near B and part of the bend near A.
A complete target boundary and the presence or absence of entities under the occlusion remain unknown.

rows.target_brief: The complete main-road cross-section from fixed B at the left junction to fixed A near the right bend, excluding the connected building frontage and parking spaces.
rows.notes: The original and guide and all three native crops covering the full A/B interval and both sides were viewed. Long white construction pieces and smaller scattered objects are visible on the paved connection. The lower side follows planted islands, but the opposite side opens continuously into the building frontage and parking area without a reliably visible main-road edge; sand and debris further obscure the transition near A. A white van is present near that frontage, with no temporal context to determine its obstruction relationship. The full road polygon cannot be drawn reliably from this view.
uncertainties: The main-road boundary against the connected building frontage is unclear; assigning the whole frontage would overstate the target.
The white van has no motion or blockage context in the single image.

rows.target_brief: The full-width curved main road from fixed A in the upper-right to fixed B at the lower-left junction; adjoining private aprons are excluded by the continuous road edges.
rows.notes: The original, guide and six overlapping native crops were inspected over the entire fixed road. Grass/pavement edges remain traceable around the curve and across driveway mouths using their two sides. Two small white pieces cast distinct local shadows and sit within the main-road pavement, near image pixels (2112,1211) and (2354,989). They are physical scattered debris, separate from the long pole/tree shadows, patched pavement and the larger destruction on adjacent properties. Parked vehicles shown on private aprons do not enter the marked road footprint.
